findings.quote: Light entries, walkways, mail areas and parking from dusk to dawn
findings.root_cause: The takeaway and spoken script omit the best-practice label used in the article's checklist. The standalone watch page needs to distinguish the recommendation from a legal lighting mandate (EVD-CONFIDENCE-LEVELS).
findings.fix: Replace the script sentence with: "As a best practice, we recommend steady dusk-to-dawn lighting at entries, walkways, mail areas and parking." On the video page, replace the corresponding takeaway with: "Best practice: provide steady dusk-to-dawn lighting at entries, walkways, mail areas and parking."
findings.future_prevention: Carry labels through the blog, watch-page takeaways and both script copies.

claim_provenance.quote: We manage 600+ rental units across Oakland, Berkeley, Emeryville and the wider East Bay. Let's talk about how your building handles lighting, doors and repair reports.
claim_provenance.note: Internal documented record, not AI-assigned owner verification. The tenant-reporting line is company practice, not a claim of routine night inspections.

claim_provenance.quote: At AEBP, our tenants see the property after dark every night. We mostly see it in daylight. So we ask them to report any light that's out or a door that won't latch. We can only fix what we know about. And once someone reports it, we do know about it.
